title: jmri-json-trainRecord-server-message
description: Data portion of message from JMRI to client for type "trainRecord"

rosterEntry.description: The id of the lead loco's roster entry, or null if it has none

placed.description: True if the train is on the layout

blocks.description: System names of the Blocks the train is in, front first when the front is known

frontKnown.description: True if the first Block is known to hold the train's front

confidence.description: How sure train tracking is of where the train is; null if it is not on the layout
